semantic_fidelity.reason: The nine historical topology entities and all eight source relationships survive, with the nic→gateway pair repeated across two views to carry latency versus address semantics. The /29, full gateway address, .58/.59 suffixes, active port, dark count, AS identifiers, hop order and text qualifiers are readable. Historical ToR/no-cable/free claims are qualified or not promoted. The latency label is an uncertainty envelope of the conflicting supplied 8.3 and 8.6 values, not an exact source quotation or a newly measured distribution. Solid address-membership and observed egress links do not erase the free? and latency qualifiers; uncertainty in state/measurement is not uncertainty about those link endpoints. Documented incidental provisioning/location drops do not delete any task-required topology entity or relation.

arrow_traceability.reason: Ten drawn arrows are traceable stem-to-unique-head, including the duplicated nic→gateway span and one clearly qualified annotation. The two thin v2 risers are separate incoming routes, not a bus or fake fork. Zero crossings or connected touching bends; the adjacent v2 bend cells do not connect. Every route is monotone and attains the Manhattan lower bound between its assigned drawn endpoints, so no loop/detour is observed despite missing route-economy telemetry. The source does not request a named trunk, and generation.json now supplies an honest source-direction rationale for no trunks; the empty check line is not a topology defect.

layout_fit.reason: All three actual final specs have app-produced pinned 77x47 natural-100% frame grids with complete boxes, full labels, zero visible crossings and no palette occlusion. Frozen metadata explicitly accepts this pinned-dump fallback as fit proof; the skill permits pinned direct --frames dumps. The distinct live panes were 83x51, not 77x47, and are recorded separately rather than relabelled. This passes rendered target-grid geometry, not a claim that the terminal pane itself measured 77x47.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: v1 server1 concepts and v2 address-pool concepts have honest proximity and hue families. However, within v3 the separate trace-caveat group has exactly the same pink RGB(211,134,155) border as the Airtel transit node, while the second Airtel hop uses a related pink. This colors a non-device uncertainty annotation as if it belongs to the upstream carrier group, although its subject is the unresolved NxtGen fabric. The dashed label keeps routing readable but does not repair this source-unsupported color grouping. A within-view hash collision is a renderer-level defect, not evidence of semantic grouping by the skill.

border_integrity.reason: All fourteen node occurrences have complete sides/corners; normal ANSI proves uniform per-node border color and all-selected ANSI proves uniform bold RGB(216,166,87) borders for 14/14. Target-size pinned text independently verifies complete border geometry and zero palette-overwritten border cells. Pinned target-size color/selection is not separately captured; the color proof is the actual ANSI capture of each final view at its measured live size, not an inference from plain text. Identical colors on different groups fail grouping, not per-node border continuity.

workflow_evidence.reason: A known reproducibility defect remains: attempts.json records a malformed 63-character SHA-256 for v1-a1, different from its actual 64-character digest (F01). In addition, exact executed commands and raw exit-status records for six rejected/fallback attempts are missing (F02); raw output alone and narrative status claims cannot fill that gap. Final spec hashes, 21 capture artifact hashes, frozen skill/binary/rubric/dataset/case hashes, separate DeepSeek/Sol identities, blind-first record, all-view frames, measured live size, target-grid dumps, and closure of all three owned panes are otherwise verified. Missing records are blockers, not passes; the known bad digest makes this category fail rather than merely blocked.

animation.reason: Source task/excerpts never request or show animation; frozen cases.json and expected.json explicitly mark this case optional, unlike the animation-required cases. Static rendering is source-backed N/A, not a passed animation test. Every edge has dots:0 and all five timestamped frames at both recorded sizes show zero route dots. There is no origin/speed/arrival claim to infer from 0/0 check counters.

findings.description: DEFECT (known, not merely missing evidence): attempts.json /views/0/attempts/0/spec_sha256 is the 63-character value 8aa57bddccd34e2cbbe569af3f6f9a0ba6b6c5a9659024e1d01d52c8e8cf6a2. The preserved v1-a1.json actually hashes to 8aa57bddccd34e2cbbe569af3f6f9a0ba6b6c5a9659024e1d01d52c8e83cf6a2 (64 characters). Therefore the rejected-attempt provenance does not faithfully identify its actual input. All final-spec and capture-artifact hashes do match. Nonvisual JSON/hash finding; no fabricated screen region is assigned.

EVIDENCE GAP / BLOCKER: the six rejected/fallback attempts have preserved output text but no preserved raw executed command plus stdout/stderr/exit-status record. attempts.json has no exit/status field for any attempt. Final-view manifest check_exit=0 covers the three finals only; a prose assertion that v3-a2 exited 1 does not recover the missing raw status. Exact rejected commands and raw statuses cannot be independently established from this bundle. Missing evidence is blocked, not passed; F01 separately makes workflow_evidence a known failure. This is a nonvisual absence, so locations are empty rather than invented.

DEFECT: in one v3 view, Airtel 14.143.x (isp transit group) and L2? hops 3,6 nil (trace caveats group) have exactly the same normal border foreground RGB(211,134,155), and Airtel BB uses related RGB(226,156,175). This places the fabric-layer uncertainty annotation in the ISP color family despite different source semantics and explicit different groups. Text/dashes preserve the caveat and edge traceability, but cannot waive the unsupported hue grouping. This is a within-view renderer hash collision, not the harmless cross-view server1/Cloudflare reuse noted by the generator.

blockers: F02: exact rejected/fallback --check commands and their raw stdout/stderr/exit-status records are missing for v1-a1, v1-a2, v2-a1, v2-a3, v3-a1 and v3-a2; no independent recovery is permitted by launching new sessions.

Evidence scope: no live 77x47 pane, target-sized ANSI/selected capture, pane rectangle, or wall-clock timestamp for pinned dumps is preserved. Frozen metadata permits final-spec pinned 77x47 dump fit proof; actual 83x51 ANSI proves per-view colors. Do not claim that these narrower records establish a 77x47 live-pane/color capture.

Capability limitation (nonblocking for the manually audited monotone paths): the frozen renderer emits no near-minimal routes telemetry. Old validator failures remain in the bundle; metadata records removal of that telemetry requirement before generation. No route-economy claim is inferred from a nonexistent check line.
